questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of "game mechanics" in game design?

options.text: To create the background music for the game
To define the rules and systems that make the game function
To design the visual art and characters
To write the storyline of the game

correct_answer.text: To define the rules and systems that make the game function

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a key difference between 2D and 3D game development?

options.text: 2D games always have better graphics than 3D games
3D games include depth and allow movement in all directions, while 2D games are flat
2D games require more powerful computers than 3D games
3D games cannot be made with free tools like Unity

correct_answer.text: 3D games include depth and allow movement in all directions, while 2D games are flat

questions.question_text: How does Augmented Reality (AR) differ from Virtual Reality (VR)?

options.text: AR fully immerses you in a digital world with a headset, while VR uses a phone screen
AR overlays digital elements onto the real world, while VR creates a completely virtual environment
VR is only used for gaming, while AR is only for education
AR requires no technology, while VR needs expensive equipment

correct_answer.text: AR overlays digital elements onto the real world, while VR creates a completely virtual environment

questions.question_text: What is a key advantage of using Scratch for beginner game developers?

options.text: It requires advanced coding knowledge in C#
It allows for drag-and-drop coding without typing complex code
It is only used for creating 3D games and VR experiences
It is a paid tool with professional-grade features

correct_answer.text: It allows for drag-and-drop coding without typing complex code

questions.question_text: When designing a simple game as part of a hands-on activity, what is an important step to ensure the game is playable?

options.text: Focus only on creating detailed graphics before testing
Test and tweak the game to balance difficulty and fix bugs
Make the game as complex as possible to impress others
Avoid sharing the game with peers for feedback

correct_answer.text: Test and tweak the game to balance difficulty and fix bugs
